description: The 'dss_apps_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about live applications, focusing on their visibility, version, and origin. It is particularly useful for managing and analyzing applications within a platform, such as Dataiku. Each application is uniquely identified by an 'appId' and includes details like version ('appVersion'), descriptive labels ('label'), and short descriptions ('shortDesc'). The dataset also captures metadata such as tags, which are stored in a JSON array format, and the source of the application, whether it is a project or a plugin ('origin'). Additionally, it includes boolean indicators for limited visibility ('onlyLimitedVisibility'), presence of an image ('isAppImg'), and usage as a recipe ('useAsRecipe'). The 'instanceCount' column provides the number of instances for each application, while the 'url' column offers direct access links. This dataset is valuable for developers and administrators who need to track application deployment, manage application instances, and ensure proper categorization and accessibility of applications within their ecosystem.
shortDesc: Dataset of live applications with visibility, version, and origin details.

columns.name: onlyLimitedVisibility
columns.comment: Indicates if app has limited visibility, boolean value.

columns.name: appId
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each application, text format.

columns.name: appVersion
columns.comment: Version information of the application, text format.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Descriptive label for the application, free text.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Short description of the application, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the application, JSON array format.

columns.name: isAppImg
columns.comment: Indicates if app has an image, boolean value.

columns.name: origin
columns.comment: Source of the application, either project or plugin.

columns.name: originProjectKey
columns.comment: Key of the originating project, text format.

columns.name: instanceCount
columns.comment: Number of instances of the application, integer value.

columns.name: useAsRecipe
columns.comment: Indicates if app is used as a recipe, boolean value.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the application, string format.
